reuse.why: expectedAmount calls the existing getScheduledAmount, which already handles missing, single and ranged amounts via the shared getRangeAmount.

duplication.why: No amount logic is repeated; one call in toExternal.

placement.why: Computed in scheduleModel.toExternal, the existing internal-to-API mapping layer.

scope.why: A single field, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: The rule stays shared, but expectedAmount is an optional field on APIScheduleEntity, which is also the create/update input type, so the read-only nature is only documented by a comment rather than the type.
